content: CAMERA / LOOK: 由拍摄对象本人使用手持迷你DV摄像机拍摄的镜头。轻微的手抖，偶尔自动对焦搜索，不完美的取景，自然的变焦调整，柔和的胶带般图像质量，细微的颗粒感，真实的自动曝光从柔和的清晨光线中变化。自然的肤色，轻微的运动模糊，真实的消费级摄像机美学。STYLE: 温馨的晨间例行Vlog，带有柔和的ASMR元素。轻松的节奏，最少的对话，真诚的瞬间。焦点放在令人满足的声音上：垫子展开、水瓶盖拧开、轻柔的脚步声、织物拉伸、温柔的呼气。SUBJECT: 二十多岁的年轻东亚女性，【打扮】、高马尾辫，最少饰品。在开始一天之前，平静、专注的能量。SETTING: 为晨间伸展清空的客厅小角落，原木地板。窗帘透入柔和的晨光，一个粉米黄色瑜伽垫，附近一个小植物，安静的氛围。STORYBOARD:→ (2s, propped medium shot) 将摄像机放在架子上，展开垫子。“一天开始前的晨间伸展。”→ (2s, overhead shot) 将垫子平整地抚平在地板上。只有展开的声音。→ (2s, close-up) 坐下，缓慢呼吸，眼睛短暂闭合。→ (2s, handheld shot) 进入一个简单的伸展，调整姿势。“只是慢慢进入状态。”→ (2s, detail shot) 在伸展间隙啜饮水。没有对话。→ (2s, medium shot) 缓慢地进行温柔的流动动作。“动一动感觉真好。”→ (2s, macro shot) 在姿势中赤脚压入垫子。→ (2s, propped shot) 耸肩，深吸一口气。→ (2s, warm ending shot) 平静地坐下，放松的微笑。“现在准备好开始一天了。”→ (1.5s, final shot) 伸手向摄像机。“待会儿见。”手覆盖镜头，录制结束。AUDIO NOTES: 自然的氛围声如垫子展开、水瓶、轻柔呼吸应清晰可闻。对话安静而随意。REALISM NOTES: 真实的肢体语言，自然的眨眼，真诚的平静表情，偶尔停顿呼吸，不完美的取景，对焦呼吸，柔和的晨光变化。应类似于使用消费级摄像机拍摄的真实个人健康Vlog，而非商业制作。

CAMERA / LOOK: Footage shot by the subject herself using a handheld mini DV camcorder. Slight hand shake, occasional autofocus hunting, imperfect framing, natural zoom adjustments, soft tape-like image quality, subtle grain, and realistic auto-exposure shifts from the gentle morning light. Natural skin tones, slight motion blur, and an authentic consumer camcorder aesthetic. STYLE: A cozy morning routine vlog with soft ASMR elements. Relaxed pacing, minimal dialogue, sincere moments. Focus on satisfying sounds: mat unfolding, water bottle cap twisting open, soft footsteps, fabric stretching, gentle exhales. SUBJECT: A young East Asian woman in her twenties, [outfit], high ponytail, minimal accessories. Calm, focused energy before starting the day. SETTING: A small cleared corner of the living room for morning stretching, with wooden floors. Soft morning light filtering through the curtains, a pink-beige yoga mat, a small plant nearby, and a quiet atmosphere. STORYBOARD:→ (2s, propped medium shot) Place the camera on a shelf and unfold the mat. “Morning stretching before the day begins.”→ (2s, overhead shot) Smooth the mat flat on the floor. Only the sound of unfolding.→ (2s, close-up) Sit down, breathe slowly, eyes briefly closed.→ (2s, handheld shot) Move into a simple stretch, adjusting posture. “Just easing into it.”→ (2s, detail shot) Sip water between stretches. No dialogue.→ (2s, medium shot) Slowly flow through gentle movements. “It feels good to move.”→ (2s, macro shot) Bare feet pressing into the mat in a pose.→ (2s, propped shot) Shrug shoulders, take a deep breath.→ (2s, warm ending shot) Sit calmly with a relaxed smile. “Ready to start the day now.”→ (1.5s, final shot) Reach toward the camera. “See you later.” Hand covers the lens, recording ends. AUDIO NOTES: Natural ambient sounds such as the mat unfolding, the water bottle, and soft breathing should be clearly audible. Dialogue is quiet and casual. REALISM NOTES: Real body language, natural blinking, a genuinely calm expression, occasional pauses in breathing, imperfect framing, breathing-focused autofocus, and soft changes in morning light. It should feel like a real personal wellness vlog shot on a consumer camcorder, not a commercial production.

es.content:
CAMERA / LOOK: Toma filmada por la propia persona, usando una mini cámara DV de mano. Ligero temblor de la mano, búsqueda ocasional de autofocus, encuadre imperfecto, ajustes naturales de zoom, una calidad de imagen suave, casi de cinta, grano sutil y autoexposición real que cambia con la luz suave de la mañana. Tono de piel natural, ligero motion blur y una estética auténtica de cámara de consumo. STYLE: Vlog cálido de rutina matutina, con suaves elementos ASMR. Ritmo relajado, diálogo mínimo, momentos sinceros. El foco está en sonidos satisfactorios: desplegar la esterilla, desenroscar la tapa de la botella, pasos suaves, estiramiento de la tela, exhalaciones delicadas. SUBJECT: Mujer joven de Asia Oriental, de veintitantos años, 【vestida】, coleta alta, accesorios mínimos. Energía tranquila y concentrada antes de empezar el día. SETTING: Un pequeño rincón del salón despejado para estiramientos matutinos, suelo de madera natural. Cortinas dejando entrar una luz suave de la mañana, una esterilla de yoga rosa beige, una pequeña planta cerca y un ambiente silencioso. STORYBOARD:→ (2s, propped medium shot) Coloca la cámara en una repisa y despliega la esterilla. “Estiramiento matutino antes de empezar el día.”→ (2s, overhead shot) Alisa la esterilla sobre el suelo. Solo se oye el sonido de desplegarla.→ (2s, close-up) Se sienta, respira despacio, con los ojos cerrados por un momento.→ (2s, handheld shot) Entra en un estiramiento sencillo, ajustando la postura. “Solo entrando en calor poco a poco.”→ (2s, detail shot) Toma un sorbo de agua entre estiramientos. Sin diálogo.→ (2s, medium shot) Realiza lentamente un movimiento suave y fluido. “Se siente bien moverse.”→ (2s, macro shot) Descalza, presiona la esterilla con los pies en la postura.→ (2s, propped shot) Encoge los hombros y toma una respiración profunda.→ (2s, warm ending shot) Se sienta con calma, con una sonrisa relajada. “Ahora sí, lista para empezar el día.”→ (1.5s, final shot) Extiende la mano hacia la cámara. “Nos vemos luego.” La mano cubre el lente y termina la grabación. AUDIO NOTES: Los sonidos ambientales naturales, como desplegar la esterilla, la botella de agua y la respiración suave, deben escucharse con claridad. El diálogo es tranquilo y casual. REALISM NOTES: Lenguaje corporal realista, parpadeo natural, expresión serena y genuina, pausas ocasionales para respirar, encuadre imperfecto, autofocus respirando, cambios suaves de la luz matutina. Debe parecer un vlog personal de bienestar real, grabado con una cámara de consumo, no una producción comercial.

fr.content:
CAMERA / LOOK : des plans filmés par le sujet lui-même avec une mini-caméra DV tenue à la main. Légers tremblements de la main, recherche occasionnelle de l’autofocus, cadrage imparfait, ajustements naturels du zoom, qualité d’image douce, presque comme une bande magnétique, grain subtil, exposition automatique réaliste qui varie avec la lumière douce du matin. Teints naturels, léger flou de mouvement, esthétique authentique de caméra grand public.  
STYLE : Vlog matinal chaleureux, avec de douces touches d’ASMR. Rythme détendu, très peu de dialogue, moments sincères. Accent mis sur les sons satisfaisants : tapis qu’on déroule, bouchon de bouteille qu’on dévisse, pas légers, tissu qui s’étire, souffle doux.  
SUBJECT : Jeune femme est-asiatique dans la vingtaine, 【打扮】, queue-de-cheval haute, très peu d’accessoires. Énergie calme et concentrée avant de commencer la journée.  
SETTING : Petit coin du salon dégagé pour des étirements du matin, parquet en bois brut. Des rideaux laissent entrer une lumière matinale douce, un tapis de yoga rose beige, une petite plante à proximité, ambiance paisible.  
STORYBOARD :  
→ (2s, propped medium shot) Poser la caméra sur une étagère et dérouler le tapis. « Étirements du matin avant de commencer la journée. »  
→ (2s, overhead shot) Lisser le tapis sur le sol. On n’entend que le bruit du déroulement.  
→ (2s, close-up) S’asseoir, respirer lentement, les yeux brièvement fermés.  
→ (2s, handheld shot) Entrer dans un étirement simple, ajuster la posture. « Juste prendre le rythme doucement. »  
→ (2s, detail shot) Boire de l’eau entre deux étirements. Aucun dialogue.  
→ (2s, medium shot) Enchaîner lentement des mouvements fluides et doux. « Ça fait du bien de bouger. »  
→ (2s, macro shot) Pieds nus qui appuient dans le tapis pendant la posture.  
→ (2s, propped shot) Hausser les épaules, prendre une grande inspiration.  
→ (2s, warm ending shot) S’asseoir calmement, sourire détendu. « Maintenant, je suis prête à commencer la journée. »  
→ (1.5s, final shot) Tendre la main vers la caméra. « À tout à l’heure. » La main couvre l’objectif, fin de l’enregistrement.  
AUDIO NOTES : Les sons d’ambiance naturels comme le tapis qu’on déroule, la bouteille d’eau et la respiration douce doivent être clairement audibles. Le dialogue est calme et spontané.  
REALISM NOTES : Langage corporel authentique, clignements naturels, expression de calme sincère, petites pauses respiratoires occasionnelles, cadrage imparfait, respiration mise au point, variations douces de la lumière du matin. Cela doit ressembler à un vrai vlog bien-être personnel filmé avec une caméra grand public, et non à une production commerciale.

ko.content:
CAMERA / LOOK: 피사체 본인이 손에 든 미니 DV 카메라로 촬영한 듯한 장면. 약간의 손떨림, 가끔씩 자동 초점이 탐색하는 느낌, 완벽하지 않은 구도, 자연스러운 줌 조정, 부드러운 테이프 같은 영상 질감, 미세한 그레인, 부드러운 아침빛에 따라 변하는 실제 자동 노출. 자연스러운 피부 톤, 약간의 모션 블러, 실제 소비자용 카메라 미학.  
STYLE: 따뜻한 아침 루틴 Vlog, 부드러운 ASMR 요소 포함. 여유로운 템포, 최소한의 대화, 진솔한 순간들. 포인트는 만족감을 주는 소리들에 있음: 매트 펼치는 소리, 물병 뚜껑을 여는 소리, 부드러운 발걸음, 천이 늘어나는 소리, 잔잔한 숨 내쉬는 소리.  
SUBJECT: 20대 초반의 젊은 동아시아 여성, 【옷차림】, 높은 포니테일, 최소한의 액세서리. 하루를 시작하기 전의 차분하고 집중된 에너지.  
SETTING: 아침 스트레칭을 위해 비워 둔 거실의 작은 한쪽 공간, 원목 바닥. 커튼 사이로 부드러운 아침 햇살이 들어오고, 분홍빛 베이지색 요가 매트, 근처의 작은 식물, 조용한 분위기.  
STORYBOARD:  
→ (2s, propped medium shot) 카메라를 선반에 올려두고 매트를 펼친다. “하루를 시작하기 전 아침 스트레칭.”  
→ (2s, overhead shot) 매트를 바닥에 고르게 펴 준다. 펼치는 소리만 들린다.  
→ (2s, close-up) 앉아서 천천히 호흡하고, 눈을 잠시 감는다.  
→ (2s, handheld shot) 간단한 스트레칭으로 들어가며 자세를 조정한다. “그냥 천천히 몸을 깨우는 중.”  
→ (2s, detail shot) 스트레칭 사이에 물을 한 모금 마신다. 대화 없음.  
→ (2s, medium shot) 천천히 부드러운 플로우 동작을 이어 간다. “몸을 움직이니 정말 좋다.”  
→ (2s, macro shot) 자세를 취한 채 맨발로 매트를 꾹 누른다.  
→ (2s, propped shot) 어깨를 으쓱하고 깊게 숨을 들이쉰다.  
→ (2s, warm ending shot) 차분히 앉아 편안하게 미소 짓는다. “이제 하루를 시작할 준비 완료.”  
→ (1.5s, final shot) 카메라를 향해 손을 뻗는다. “이따 봐.” 손이 렌즈를 덮으며 녹화 종료.  
AUDIO NOTES: 매트 펼치는 소리, 물병 소리, 부드러운 호흡 같은 자연스러운 환경음이 또렷하게 들려야 한다. 대화는 조용하고 자연스럽다.  
REALISM NOTES: 실제 같은 몸짓, 자연스러운 눈 깜빡임, 진솔하고 차분한 표정, 가끔 멈추는 호흡, 완벽하지 않은 구도, 호흡에 맞춰 초점이 움직이는 느낌, 부드럽게 변하는 아침빛. 상업적 제작물이 아니라 소비자용 카메라로 촬영한 실제 개인 웰니스 Vlog처럼 보여야 한다.

Leve tremor de mão, busca ocasional de autofoco, enquadramento imperfeito, ajustes naturais de zoom, qualidade de imagem suave, com aparência de fita, granulação sutil, autoexposição realista variando com a luz suave da manhã. Ritmo relaxado, diálogo mínimo, momentos genuínos. Foco nos sons satisfatórios: o tapete sendo desenrolado, a tampa da garrafa de água sendo aberta, passos leves, tecido se esticando, expirações suaves. SUBJECT: Jovem mulher do Leste Asiático na faixa dos vinte anos, 【打扮】, rabo de cavalo alto, poucos acessórios. Energia calma e concentrada antes de começar o dia. SETTING: Pequeno canto da sala de estar liberado para alongamento matinal, piso de madeira natural.
